title: The Flawed Foundations of Fair Machine Learning
findings: The paper does not analyze, measure, or mention any aspect of religion or faith. Its focus is a conceptual and mathematical critique of the foundations of fair machine learning, using abstract notions of 'sensitive attributes' and 'group disparities' without specifying them in terms of religion.
